opening.argument: The speaker opens by saying he is playing Tech Support: Error Unknown, and the title identifies the video as gameplay. The game is described as an adventure with simulation and puzzle mechanics set at a virtual computer. In that context, the payment request, urgent bank-transfer appeal, security-code message, anti-Quasar email, and intermediary-routing instruction are gameplay events or dialogue, not offers made to viewers. The speaker closes by calling it an episode of Let's Game It Out. There is no indication that the creator asks viewers to act on any of those in-game messages.
